newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Agricultural producers blocked several main roads in the country in protest against 1997 tax and social security contribution rules.
- Sandor Puskas, Chairman of the state privatisation agency APV offered to leave his post, six months after a scandal over irregular payments shook APV.
- A rally against M5 motorway fees, believed to be high, is likely to be held next week.
- Only a dozen people took part in a demonstration, held at the Hungarian embassy in Moscow, against Hungary's planned NATO-membership.
